slides.title: Your senior officer is *difficult*. Now what?
Stop trying to *win*
slides.body: You won't out-argue a senior mid-watch. Learn how they want reports and handovers, then deliver exactly that.

slides.title: Raise it once, in private
slides.body: Not in front of the crew. After the watch: one specific example, one calm question.

slides.title: Know your *line*
slides.body: Some things aren't "just the job". The MLC gives you an on-board complaint procedure, including the right to go straight to the Master.

slides.a: Keep your head down and survive the contract.
slides.b: Predictable work and one calm talk change more than silence.

slides.question: What helped you with a difficult senior?
slides.line: Built at sea by a serving 2nd Officer.
